hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -euo pipefail
ts() { date -u +%FT%TZ; } log() { echo "[$(ts)] $*" >&2; }
# Config PARALLEL="${PARALLEL:-8}" BUCKET="avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl" EXCLUDE_STUDY_ID=""
mkdir -p logs data completed hierarchies processing
# Clean working dirs rm -f data/* processing/* completed/* logs/* 2>/dev/null || true rm -rf pic-sure-hpds/ || true
# Require managed_inputs : "${managed_inputs:?managed_inputs env var is required (e.g. s3://.../Managed_Inputs.csv)}"
# ---- assume role once (covers all aws calls below) ---- log "Assuming role arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl ..." read -r AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN < <( aws sts assume-role \ --duration-seconds 3600 \ --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl \ --role-session-name "s3-test" \ --query 'Credentials.[AccessKeyId,SecretAccessKey,SessionToken]' \ --output text ) export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
aws sts get-caller-identity --output text >/dev/null log "Role assumed successfully."
# Download Managed_Inputs log "Downloading Managed_Inputs from: ${managed_inputs}" aws s3 cp "${managed_inputs}" data/ --no-progress --only-show-errors log "Downloaded Managed_Inputs to data/"
# Build inputs.csv (keeps header) log "Building inputs.csv" csvcut -c \ "Study Abbreviated Name","Study Identifier","Study Type","Data is ready to process","Data Processed","Has Multi" \ data/Managed_Inputs.csv > inputs.csv
if [ ! -s inputs.csv ]; then log "ERROR: inputs.csv missing or empty" exit 1 fi log "inputs.csv ready."
# Build a null-delimited list of ready Study Abbreviated Name values (excluding Study Identifier == phs003463) log "Filtering ready studies (excluding Study Identifier == ${EXCLUDE_STUDY_ID})" python3 - <<PY > /tmp/ready_studies.nul import csv, sys EXCLUDE_STUDY_ID = "${EXCLUDE_STUDY_ID}"
count = 0 with open("inputs.csv", newline="") as f: r = csv.DictReader(f) for row in r: ready = (row.get("Data is ready to process") or "").strip().lower() study_id = (row.get("Study Identifier") or "").strip() if ready != "yes": continue if study_id == EXCLUDE_STUDY_ID: continue name = (row.get("Study Abbreviated Name") or "").strip() if name: sys.stdout.write(name + "\0") count += 1
sys.stderr.write(f"READY_STUDIES_COUNT={count}\n") PY log "Ready studies list built."
# Parallel downloads of PatientMapping files log "Starting parallel downloads (PARALLEL=${PARALLEL}) ..." xargs -0 -P "$PARALLEL" -I{} bash -c ' set -euo pipefail ts() { date -u +%FT%TZ; } slog() { echo "[$(ts)] $*" >&2; }
abv="$1" lower="${abv,,}" upper="${abv^^}"
src="s3://'"$BUCKET"'/${lower}/data/${upper}_PatientMapping.v2.csv" dest="data/${upper}_PatientMapping.v2.csv"
slog "START ${upper} $src" for attempt in 1 2 3; do if aws s3 cp "$src" "$dest" --no-progress --only-show-errors; then bytes="$(wc -c < "$dest" 2>/dev/null || echo "?")" slog "DONE ${upper} -> $dest (${bytes} bytes)" exit 0 fi slog "RETRY ${upper} attempt=${attempt} failed; sleeping $((attempt*2))s" sleep $((attempt * 2)) done
slog "FAIL ${upper} after retries" exit 1 ' _ {} < /tmp/ready_studies.nul
log "All PatientMapping downloads completed."
# Drop creds unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN log "AWS credentials unset."
log "Running HPDSPatientNumTracker.jar --revengineer" java -jar jars/entity-generator-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT-HPDSPatientNumTracker.jar --auditcollisions log "Done."
